up: Retrieve exact IC50 activity values for compounds tested against human dipeptidyl peptidase-4 (CHEMBL284). Include only activities where a PubMed ID or DOI exists. Return the compound ChEMBL ID, canonical SMILES, compound key, PubMed ID (prefer this over DOI), DOI (if PubMed ID is missing), assay description, target ChEMBL ID, and target preferred name. Ensure that activity rows with missing PubMed ID and DOI are excluded from the results.
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
  md.chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id,
  cs.canonical_smiles,
  cr.compound_key,
  COALESCE(d.pubmed_id, d.doi) AS pubmed_id_or_doi,
  a.description AS assay_description,
  td.chembl_id AS target_chembl_id,
  td.pref_name AS target_name
FROM activities act
JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id
JOIN target_dictionary td ON a.tid = td.tid
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON act.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
JOIN compound_records cr ON act.record_id = cr.record_id
JOIN docs d ON act.doc_id = d.doc_id
WHERE
  td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL284'
  AND act.standard_type = 'IC50'
  AND act.standard_relation = '='
  AND (d.pubmed_id IS NOT NULL OR d.doi IS NOT NULL);
